card.no_entity: Select an entity from the Škola OnLine – Marks integration.

editor.title: Custom title (optional)
editor.size_by_weight_description: Scales a mark's chip size based on where its weight falls between the lightest and heaviest weight shown (works regardless of which weight scale the school uses).
editor.show_empty_subjects: Show subjects with no marks yet
editor.new_mark_days_description: How many school days a mark stays highlighted as new (1 = today only; weekends don't count, so 2 reaches back to last Friday on a Monday). 0 turns the highlight off entirely.
editor.subjects_description: Drag to reorder subjects on the card, click the color dot to set a subject's color.
